description_short: Identify host materials that occur in two or more different application domains in comparison R1469955 and list, for each such host, the applications and dopants under which it is used.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

postprocessing_notes.aggregation: Stage 1 aggregates per host to count distinct applications (n_apps) and selects hosts with n_apps >= 2. Stage 2 enumerates, for these hosts, all (application, dopant) pairs, enabling analysis of cross-functional hosts that support multiple application domains via different dopants.
